title: Classification of dynamics for a two person model of planned behavior
summary: We study a dynamical system modeling the Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB) in which each individual's behavioral intention evolves continuously under an ODE driven by internal attitudes, perceived social norms, and perceived behavioral control. Actions occur as discrete threshold events: when intention reaches a fixed threshold it is reset to 0 and produces a transient "nudge" that jumps to 1 and then decays exponentially.
